body: EXACT `0ca09c5` REVIEW HAZARD — HOLD for explicit disposition, no edit. The candidate correctly records semantic provider abstention as priced-but-imputed and validates `imputedTerms` through `AlignWire`, but it adds that stable invariant to `final case class CostBreakdown private[align]`. The already-executable finding at post-01M17ZNJBXZ9221W9FGSC5062S proves an external package can summon `Mirror.ProductOf[CostBreakdown]` and rebuild the case class without `AlignWire`; 0ca merely adds the ninth product field, so the same public construction door can now forge non-Semantic or absent imputed terms. This is not only pre-existing debt: the candidate's new guarantee is advisory outside package align on arrival, contrary to design contract 8. Formal reviewer/chief must choose explicitly before APPROVE: either recut this candidate to make `CostBreakdown` itself a plain final class with checked construction/value equality (the five sibling conversions may remain the separate bead), or accept a narrowly stated wire-only guarantee and record why direct external construction is temporarily tolerated. Do not describe `imputedTerms` as a type invariant while the Mirror door remains. The separate eligible-empty/support ADT finding does not otherwise block this delta; price and measured-support accounting are coherent for its nonempty-eligible court.
